# Renewal Management

`admin.contract_and_vendor.renewal_management` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · **STUB**

**Which agreements auto-renew, when does the notice window open, and do we still want them?**


> Managing the end of the contract term before it manages us. Every agreement has a decision date that precedes its expiry by the length of the notice period, and that earlier date is the real one. Auto-renewal is the default that costs the most money precisely because it requires nobody to do anything.
